notes.title: RACING BROS: ONLINE PLAYTEST 0.01 OUT
notes.content:
We just released our first playtest to let the community test the maps, the gameplay and the sync between players. Break and test everything and report back!

Be adviced that nothing is ready, except the basic map logic and the standard gameplay.

We had some issues with lag and desync. Please test if this works.
Please also print screen the player list *TAB*(with ping info) when there is a lag/sync issue and send it to us. We need to find out if this is on the server side or the client side.

There are 5 maps in closed rotation.
There is a text chat function in lobby and in-game.
3 Car types with 3 different colors.
Nickname edit in main screen.

Enjoy and report back in discord or to our email-address found on 4gladiators.no
